signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Blue action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

deep-dusk.$description: Deep Dusk — Gradient terminal stop, button shadow depth — dark indigo that anchors the primary blue toward night

azure-crest.$description: Azure Crest — Supporting palette color for small decorative accents when the core palette needs contrast. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

hover-glow.$description: Hover Glow — Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Maximum-emphasis text, logo wordmark, icon fills — true black for highest hierarchy

carbon.$description: Carbon — Primary body and heading text — near-black with slight warmth, softer than pure black for long reading

slate.$description: Slate — Navigation text, icon strokes, secondary headings — dark cool gray for nav and structural elements

steel.$description: Steel — Muted body text, helper text — medium gray for supporting copy

fog.$description: Fog — Tertiary text, captions, disabled states — lighter gray for de-emphasized content

mist.$description: Mist — Icon strokes (most frequent use at 56 stroke instances), placeholder icons, secondary strokes — the workhorse cool-gray for line work

vapor.$description: Vapor — Card surface tint, body background alternates, subtle elevation base — cool off-white for layered surfaces

frost.$description: Frost — Tinted card background, hero-adjacent surfaces — barely-blue white that whispers atmospheric color

chalk.$description: Chalk — Primary card surface, page background, button text — pure white for max-brightness layers

bone.$description: Bone — Hairline borders (2500+ instances), dividers, input borders, icon borders — the dominant structural line color

ash.$description: Ash — Secondary borders, separator lines — slightly darker than Bone for tiered dividers

neon.$description: Neon — Green outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges

cyan-veil.$description: Cyan Veil — Subtle highlight wash, code-block tints, decorative gradient stop — cool cyan as atmospheric detail

eb-garamond.$description: Display headline — serif at 80px with -0.012em tracking is the signature move; only used for the hero '#1 Undetectable AI for Meetings' title, creating editorial gravitas against the sans-serif body. This anti-tech choice distinguishes Cluely from generic SaaS.

geist.$description: All UI text — body copy, headings, buttons, nav, labels. Geist's tight letter-spacing at large sizes (-0.04em at 48px+) creates compact, engineered headlines. Weight 300 available for whisper-quiet secondary text, weight 500-600 for active states. The wide size range (9-56px) supports everything from micro-labels to section headings.

ui-monospace.$description: Code snippets, technical labels — system monospace at 10px, never decorative, only functional in product-mockup contexts
